// REQ: LANG-1781 LANG-1782 LANG-1783 LANG-1784
struct VertexOut {
    @builtin(position) pos: vec4f,
    @location(0) color: vec3f,
};

@group(0) @binding(0) var<uniform> mvp: mat4x4f;

/* Vertex shader */
@vertex
fn vs_main(@location(0) p: vec3f) -> VertexOut {
    var out: VertexOut;
    out.pos = mvp * vec4f(p, 1.0);
    out.color = clamp(p * 0.5 + 0.5, vec3f(0.0), vec3f(1.0));
    return out;
}
